final_claim_map.claim_scope: Queue maxsize limits waiting entries; four workers add up to four retrieved jobs; queues are not thread-safe.
Queue size is waiting entries; acceptance occurs on successful put; queue size and join do not express business success.
One task_done per retrieved job; failures/cancellations remain non-success; temp creation and replacement API limits.
Graceful shutdown rejects new/blocked putters while already queued work remains drainable; join reflects queue acknowledgments.
Immediate shutdown drains waiting work and adjusts unfinished count; join may return without conversions succeeding; an active retrieved item remains separately unfinished until acknowledgment.
Task cancellation is cooperative and blocking CPU work can delay the event loop; child-process termination is outside this queue layer.
24 accepted nonterminal queue-plus-worker jobs under stated assumptions; 12-job 6-second and 120-job 2/s idealized schedule.
shutdown() exists in 3.13; sentinel fallback is for older targets; blocking work requires separate execution choices.
Executed witness scope, runtime, results, and limits; upstream tests inspected but not run; application tests and measurements remain future validation.
Draft history preserved; no deployment, crash-recovery, or discovery-effectiveness claim.
